answer: Anchor each agent identity to a distinct registered legal entity, verified against a public business registry: the registration number binds to the agent key, the entity must stay in good standing, and one company anchors at most one identity. Like a garden where every plot needs its own deed, each extra identity costs a real incorporation. A Sybil farmer wanting a hundred clones must form a hundred companies, leaving a trail along the ridge of shared incorporators. One jade seal cannot stamp a hundred deeds. Honest operators pay once; the attacker pays again for every fake.
